_comment: PreToolUse wiring for the Unity editor-lock guard. This is a DOCUMENTATION snippet, not an auto-installed config: the skill is gated in _incubator/ and installs nothing. To use it, merge this `hooks` block into the consuming project's Claude Code settings.json and point `command` at wherever unity_lock_guard.py is deployed. The matcher fires the guard before any unityMCP / aura-unity tool call; the guard itself lets read-only tools through. Verbatim from ProjectBroadside's .claude/settings.json.
